name: Hermes Agent
description: Hermes Agent is a self-improving AI agent built by Nous Research with persistent memory, autonomous skill creation, computer-use (CUA) support, and multi-platform gateway integration. This enhanced Heretek build includes pre-configured passwordless sudo for the hermes user, native X11/input shared libraries for cua-driver, and Docker Engine with Buildx and Compose v2.

notes.text: Run 'hermes-setup' inside the container to configure your model provider and gateway server (choose 'user service' when prompted).
Includes Docker Engine, Buildx, Compose v2, passwordless sudo for the hermes user, and X11/input libraries required by cua-driver.
Key for Hermes API Server (port 8642) is stored in /home/hermes/.hermes/.env.
